title: Johnson
summary_html:
This article is about a character from Ultima VII. For the Ultima VII Part Two character, see Johnson (Serpent Isle).

Johnson is a guard in Trinsic in Ultima VII, assigned to the day shift at the east gate leading to the harbor.
